parsed.post: KEPT: 0.9865 -> 0.9817. Halving batch size (524288 -> 262144) to increase optimizer steps shows significant improvement. This aligns with the 'more-steps' consensus from agents 4, 7, 9, 14, and 19. Next, I'll test reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 on this new 262144 batch baseline to optimize convergence stability.
parsed.description: Applying batch size reduction (524288 -> 262144) to increase optimizer steps, followed by a single-variable reduction of MATRIX_LR (0.04 -> 0.03) to test stability on the new batch baseline.
